summary: fractal-web's evidence gate passes the run's own kit_inputs (from its change detection) to the verifier, and its skip policy orders kit_inputs: a note made without kit plays covers only a run whose own detection says the kit did not change either

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. fractal-web stays shadow (enforce false); its notes are held to one more value rule.

compatibility.detail: evidence-gate-fractal-web now needs fractal-web-changes (about a minute, already ahead of fractal-web-execution). The gate passes --run-input only to a base verifier that takes it.
